title: Offline task board / 離線待辦看板
description: Runnable single HTML task manager: add/edit/delete tasks, move between todo/doing/done, search, localStorage persistence, JSON import/export. Safe text rendering, keyboard form, responsive. No backend, network or dependencies.
usage: Copy index.html. All state is local to the browser and can be exported/imported as JSON. Change labels/styles with normal edit tools.
verification: Chromium fixture acceptance 2026-10-02: controls/persistence/offline and canonical game captures exercised. Full-board wins and physical Safari unverified. Fixture evidence is not future model-delivery evidence.
